description: This file contains a set of utility functions for managing LEDs in an OpenWrt device, including functions to get LED paths, set LED attributes, and control LED blinking patterns.

methods.name: get_dt_led_path
methods.description: Constructs and returns the device tree path for a specified LED identifier.

methods.name: get_dt_led_color_func
methods.description: Determines the color label of an LED based on device tree properties such as function, color, or enumerator.

methods.name: get_dt_led
methods.description: Retrieves the LED label based on device tree path and properties.

methods.name: led_set_attr
methods.description: Sets a specific attribute for a given LED by writing to sysfs.

methods.name: led_timer
methods.description: Configures LED to blink using timer trigger with specified on/off delays.

methods.name: led_on
methods.description: Turns the LED on by setting brightness to maximum.

methods.name: led_off
methods.description: Turns the LED off by setting brightness to zero.

methods.name: status_led_restore_trigger
methods.description: Restores the default trigger for a status LED from device tree does.

methods.name: status_led_set_timer
methods.description: Sets the status LEDs to blink with specified on/off durations.

methods.name: status_led_set_heartbeat
methods.description: Configures the status LED to a heartbeat trigger.

methods.name: status_led_on
methods.description: Turns on the primary and secondary status LEDs.

methods.name: status_led_off
methods.description: Turns off the primary and secondary status LEDs.

methods.name: status_led_blink_slow
methods.description: Sets the status LED to blink slowly.

methods.name: status_led_blink_fast
methods.description: Sets the status LED to blink quickly.

methods.name: status_led_blink_preinit
methods.description: Pre-initialization blinking pattern for the status LED.

methods.name: status_led_blink_failsafe
methods.description: Failsafe blinking pattern for the status LED.
